title: General
description: The URLs this instance is reached at, and its license.

url.label: Application URL
url.description: The URL users access Attraccess at (used for redirects, links, and API callbacks).

errors.invalid: Enter a full URL, including http:// or https://.

publicInternetUrl.label: Public Internet URL
publicInternetUrl.description: Optional URL used for external callbacks (e.g. SumUp).

errors.invalid: Enter a full URL, including http:// or https://.

licenseKey.label: License Key
licenseKey.description: Paste a new license key to update. Leave empty to keep the current one.

activityVisibility.label: Who can see equipment activity
activityVisibility.description: Controls who sees which machines are in use and by whom. People always see their own sessions.
activityVisibility.all: All equipment (everyone who can view resources)
activityVisibility.introducedHint: Only people who may use a machine, its introducers and maintainers, and managers see its activity. On machines that allow supervised use, everyone else sees only free or in use.
activityVisibility.loadFailed: The visibility setting could not be loaded.
